main_question: 在有限交互下，建立与实际能力匹配、且能支持任务组合的技能契约。
seed_rule: first archived trajectory sample in seed_phase; identical seed for all six queries
notes: Designed tray-channel geometry, not a natural failure dataset or untouched test set.
The 44mm cube fits inside the fixed 80mm channel; real robot collision geometry is screened without resizing fingers or cube.
Only independent scratch MjData positions are assigned for FK/IK; no actuator rollout, reset settling, grasp force or lift is executed.
Archived initial object state is reused; arm seed comes from the first archived grasp-phase sample, not a pose search.
Yaw zero and ninety retain hand +z down; neither is a full-pose side grasp.
Positive static screening does not prove path feasibility, dynamics, stable grasp or task success.
No retries, additional yaw/width sweep, geometry tuning or safety threshold changes after results.
